scenarios.criterion: Given a workspace whose run-state.json holds absolute paths under the repository root, when ArchiveRecords runs, then the archived run-state.json holds the same paths relative to the repository root, slash-separated.
scenarios.name: Archived run-state.json stores paths relative to the repository root
given: A workspace's run-state.json records file paths as absolute paths under the repository root
when: The run's delivery records are archived
then: The archived run-state.json holds those same paths relative to the repository root
Each relative path uses forward slashes as separators

scenarios.criterion: Given a path in run state that is not under the repository root, such as a spec outside the checkout, when the records are archived, that path is kept unchanged — never turned into a ../ path and never dropped.
scenarios.name: A path outside the repository root is archived unchanged
given: A workspace's run state records a path that is not under the repository root, such as a spec file outside the checkout
when: The run's delivery records are archived
then: The archived run state holds that path exactly as it was, byte for byte
The path is not rewritten as a relative '../' path
The path is not dropped from the archived record

scenarios.criterion: Given a run-events.jsonl line whose text contains the absolute repository root, such as a stage error quoting a file path, when the records are archived, the archived line has the root prefix removed and is otherwise unchanged. Every archived line still parses as JSON.
scenarios.name: An absolute repository root quoted inside a run-events.jsonl line is stripped on archive
given: A workspace's run-events.jsonl contains a line whose text quotes the absolute repository root, such as a stage error message quoting a file path
when: The run's delivery records are archived
then: The archived run-events.jsonl line has the repository root prefix removed from that text
The archived line is otherwise unchanged
Every line in the archived run-events.jsonl still parses as valid JSON

scenarios.criterion: Given the change is complete, no archived run-state.json, run-events.jsonl or state/*.json contains the absolute repository root as a substring, and a test asserts this.
scenarios.name: No archived delivery record contains the absolute repository root
given: A run's delivery records, including run-state.json, run-events.jsonl, and any state/*.json documents, have been archived
then: None of run-state.json, run-events.jsonl, or any state/*.json file contains the absolute repository root as a substring

scenarios.criterion: Given the records are archived, the workspace's own run-state.json and run-events.jsonl are byte-identical to what they were before, and a test asserts this.
scenarios.name: Archiving leaves the workspace's own records untouched
given: A workspace has a run-state.json and a run-events.jsonl before archiving
when: The run's delivery records are archived
then: The workspace's run-state.json is byte-identical to what it was before archiving
The workspace's run-events.jsonl is byte-identical to what it was before archiving

scenarios.criterion: Given archived records with relative paths, when loom memory ingest reads docs/features/*/, it ingests the run exactly as it did before. The existing memory tests still pass.
scenarios.name: Memory ingest reads an archived run with relativized paths the same as before
given: Delivery records for a run have been archived with relative paths under docs/features/<feature>/
then: The run is ingested exactly as it was before paths were relativized
The existing memory tests still pass

scenarios.criterion: Given the change is complete, go test ./internal/memory/... ./cmd/loom/... passes, every new function has cyclomatic complexity below 7, and no file outside scope.paths changes except this run's own delivery record.
scenarios.name: The change meets its build, complexity, and scope guarantees
then: Every new function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
No file outside scope.paths changes except this run's own delivery record
